key.name: device-name
key.summary: The name phones show for this computer
key.description: Empty means the computer's own name. Phones accept 1 to 32 characters and none of the quotes, commas, colons, full stops, exclamation and question marks, brackets and angle brackets: the program takes those out.

key.name: clipboard-send
key.summary: Send this computer's clipboard to the phones
key.description: Text only. Whatever is copied on this computer is sent to every paired phone that is connected and takes it. Off as the image ships, because a copied password would go with it.

key.name: clipboard-receive
key.description: Text only. What a paired phone sends from its clipboard is put on this computer's clipboard. Off as the image ships, because a phone could then paste into any field you paste into.

key.name: photo-folder
key.summary: Where pictures from a phone are put
key.description: pictures puts them in Pictures/Phone; downloads puts them with the phone's other files, in Downloads/Phone.

key.name: computers
key.description: Other computers with the phone link on are listed, paired with the same key check and talked to, on the networks named home, for files and the clipboard. Off as the image ships: only phones and tablets are. A computer paired before is kept while it is off, and connects again once it is on.

key.name: music
key.description: This computer's players are shown on the paired phones and played from there, and a phone's player is shown in the live pill and played from here. The titles go only to the phones you paired, on the networks named home. Off as the image ships.

key.name: clicker
key.summary: The phone as a slide clicker
key.description: While Present mode is presenting, a paired phone's presenter may go to the next or previous slide or blank the screen (Page Down, Page Up and B), and nothing else. Not presenting, the phone can send no key at all. Off as the image ships.
